regression.explanation: Using Autoregressive features, MAE drops to 182.06 MW and RMSE drops to 242.41 MW (down from ~1,517 MW in calendar baselines). The Outlier Gap shrinks to +60.35 MW (+33.1%), demonstrating that real-time load momentum eliminates heavy-tailed prediction spikes during weather transitions.

imbalance.explanation: On the 24,255 chronological test samples, the Autoregressive model achieves 96.94% accuracy with only 741 total misclassifications (FP=394, FN=347), dramatically outperforming the calendar baseline (> 4,800 errors). Both ROC-AUC (0.9965) and PR-AUC (0.9941) exceed 0.99, demonstrating exceptional discrimination.
